name: theme-midnight
summary: Dark-leaning, high-contrast theme for Web and Admin: near-black navy and a vivid violet accent.
description: Restyles the Web application and the Admin Console through design tokens only: near-black navy surfaces, bright high-contrast text, clearly visible borders, and a vivid violet accent in dark mode; light mode keeps the identity with midnight-navy controls and deep ink text. Every checked readable pair meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 in both modes. No component changes; remove the plugin to return to the default tokens.
use_when: the product targets developers or night-time use and should look dark and bold
the builder asks for a dark, midnight, neon, or high-contrast look
the brand needs a vivid accent that stays readable on dark surfaces
